name: golden
description: A small hand-built set that stresses the behaviours Memora claims: facts that change over time, facts that must be combined, exact identifiers, contradictions, restatements, and questions the system should refuse to answer. Small enough to run for cents on every write-path change, and categorised like LoCoMo so its numbers sit next to the public benchmarks.

questions.q: What are the user's dietary restrictions?
questions.gold: The user is vegan and dislikes cilantro.
